title: Chain-of-Sanitized-Thoughts: Plugging PII Leakage in CoT of Large Reasoning Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, PII-CoT-Bench, measures the leakage of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in the chain-of-thought reasoning of Large Reasoning Models, focusing on domains like medical and financial data.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on PII leakage and privacy-preserving reasoning in non-religious contexts.
